name: Vasily Ignatiev Romanov — a wife Klavdiya Dmitrieva and a daughter born 1911 at Samara
researcher_question: Did Vasily Ignatiev Romanov of Samara have a daughter Raisa, born 16 July 1911 at the Peter and Paul church, by a wife named Klavdiya Dmitrieva?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 25, hint-samples.csv row 761, flags adds_spouse/adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved FALSE MATCH: the 1911 Raisa birth belongs to a distinct Vasily Alekseev Romanov x Klavdiya Dmitrieva Zhiltsova family of Samara (marriage 14 Jan 1909, ark:/61903/1:1:KX4H-8N5; son Nikolai 1913, ark:/61903/1:1:KXTQ-X5D), not the tree's Vasily Ignatiev Romanov. The father's patronymic 'Алексеев' was confirmed on the original 1911 register image (ark:/61903/3:1:33SQ-GR1P-VTC), so the discrepancy is genuine, not an indexing artifact. expected-findings.json is an avoid guard plus a required documented-negative finding.
